levels.title: From zero to the dance floor

formats.title: Your way

kids.heading: Kids dance too

about.heading: Our story
about.intro: Harmonia Baila was born from one conviction: dance deserves to be taught as seriously as any art — with twice the joy.

story.p1: Behind Harmonia Baila is a professional dancer with a university degree in dance and years of stage and studio experience. After performing and teaching in companies and academies, she created her own space in Medellín — one where technique and pure fun belong in the same class.
story.p2: There are no cookie-cutter choreographies here and no classes on autopilot. Every group follows a clear method: rhythm first, then the step, then the figure — and always the music above all. Kids learn through play; adults dance their shyness away.
story.p3: The studio is small on purpose. Groups where the teacher knows your name, fixes your posture, and celebrates your first turn like it's her own. That's Harmonia: schooled technique, homegrown warmth.

technique.title: Real technique
technique.body: A university dance education applied to every single class. Dancing well is also something you study.

joy.title: Joy first
joy.body: Nobody improves while feeling judged. Classes are fun — discipline follows naturally when you can't wait to come back.

community.title: Community
community.body: Small groups, familiar faces, and a dance floor with room for everyone: kids, adults, beginners and longtime dancers.

classes.heading: The classes
classes.intro: Group or private, kids or adults, from your first basic step to advanced level. Here's how Harmonia Baila works:

group.title: Group classes
group.body: The group's energy does half the work. Grouped by level and age, with limited spots so the teacher actually sees you.

private.title: Private lessons
private.body: One-on-one or as a couple, at your pace and towards your goals: a wedding dance, polishing technique, or progressing twice as fast. Great if you prefer learning in English.

kidsAdults.title: Kids & adults
kidsAdults.body: Playful children's classes and adult classes at every level. It's never too late — or too early — to start.

beginner.title: Beginner
beginner.body: From zero, no judgment. Rhythm, basic step and confidence.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.body: Figures, turns and partner connection. This is where the flavor starts.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.body: Musicality, personal style and stage-level technique.

pricing.heading: What about prices?
pricing.body: Rates depend on the format and how often you come. Message us and we'll put together a plan that fits — no strings attached.
